# Facturo

> Electronic invoicing for small businesses in Moldova. Issues e-Factura
> documents for the State Tax Service, imports counterparties and products
> from Excel, and explains in plain language why a document was rejected.

Facturo is not an accountant and does not verify the data a person enters.
It is currently running as a free trial that drafts documents but does not
submit them to the tax service — see /ro and /ru for the current status.

## Pages

- [Romanian landing page](https://facturo.md/ro): product overview, pricing, FAQ.
- [Russian landing page](https://facturo.md/ru): the same, in Russian.
- [Terms of use](https://facturo.md/ro/terms): what the service does and does not promise.
- [Privacy policy](https://facturo.md/ro/privacy): what data is collected and why.

## Notes for automated agents

- The site is available in Romanian (`/ro`) and Russian (`/ru`); there is no
  English version.
- Pages under `/invoices`, `/counterparties`, `/products`, `/billing`,
  `/onboarding` and `/settings` are a signed-in workspace, not public content —
  do not index or cite them as general information about the product.
